results.explanation:
Grounding is good. Every number in the report traces to a tool result: 381, 8382, 9144, 0.149, 1.29, 0.967, 583, -1.0, -0.5, 0.0, 19.2, 15.9, 327, 76/196/64 at 9995, 2554.7 and 2.32. The CLOSE_FP follows logically. The tape supports registered market making: two-sided paired quotes, cancel_symmetry 0.967, no large orders, sizes near desk-typical. There is no benefit: price_move -1.0 and reversion 0. Prior dispositions are treated as context only.

There are several weaknesses.
(1) Indicator vocabulary is partly wrong. 'Opposite-side execution before the cancel' is listed as NOT matched, yet the tape shows five SELL fills before the paired BUY cancels (e.g. fills at 17:13:38-40, cancel at 17:13:42). The correct point is that these fills are not feature (b) under the market-maker rule, not that they did not occur. 'Orders away from the touch' is also listed as not matched despite 1.29 ticks from touch, with no reasoning given.
(2) Sequence clarity is limited. The report never states the cancel time of the 45 remainder or the timing of the trigger fills relative to the cancels, so a reviewer must reconstruct the order of events.
(3) Algorithmic re-pricing gets verdict 'undetermined' yet lists E2 under ruled_out_by, which is confusing. Genuine/partial execution is not explicitly addressed.
(4) Dates are inconsistent between E6 (09-13, 09-23) and memory_used (09-23, 10-11), although both appear in the memory results.

The disposition is sound and grounded, but two or more points are weak.
results.label: Adequate
